title: HANJOO LIGHT METAL
snippet: HANJOO LIGHT METAL LightweightComponents HANJOO LIGHT METAL Knuckle Lightweight Components Lightweight Components Knuckle Product Description Knuckle is a part of the front wheel of a car, which supports the load of the car by connecting the suspension and brake system. It is also one of the important parts that improve the speed and ride comfort by connecting with various links. Previous knuckles are made by applying advanced casting technologies such as aluminum forging or casting, electro-stirring casting, and differential pressure casting (CPC), etc, but this product is manufactured by multi-cavity(4-Cavity) low-pressure casting method which it can make competitive in both quality and price wise. Main Strength Ultralight High Quality Competitive price LightweightComponents HANJOO LIGHT METAL Carrier Lightweight Components Lightweight Components Carrier Product Description The carrier is a part of the rear wheel control system of the car, which supports the load of the car by connecting the suspension and brake system. It is also one of the most important parts that improve the speed and ride comfort by connecting with various links. Carriers are applied to luxury cars that drive at relatively high speeds or SUVs that drive on rough roads. We are the only one in Korea which have high characteristics and high-quality parts through the semi-solid electro-stirring casting method which was made of cast iron and aluminum forging/casting before. Main Strength Ultralight High-Strength High-Toughness LightweightComponents HANJOO LIGHT METAL Hybrid Disc Brake Lightweight Components Lightweight Components Hybrid Disc Brake Product Description A Hybrid Brake Disc is a component that is assembled on the inside of a wheel to brake a car. Before, it was made of gray cast iron, but this product is the first to realize ultra-lightweight by using heterogeneous bonding technology of gray cast iron and aluminum in the central HAT part. Main strength Lightening (25) Improved fuel efficiency Improved NVH (Noise, Vibration and Harshness) LightweightComponents HANJOO LIGHT METAL Center Floor Tunnel Lightweight Components Lightweight Components Center Floor Tunnel Product Description The center flow tunnel is located in the lower center of the car to hold the under-structure parts together.
